metadata.division: AI Center of Excellence (CAIO: Nimrod Barak / VP AI Innovation: Dan Weis)

strengths: Mature SaaS UI with out-of-the-box embedding drift visualizations
Zero internal Kubernetes cluster management overhead
disqualifiers_for_syf: REJECTED BY CISO: Requires egress of Tier-1 Cardholder Data (PAN/SSN) and CareCredit PHI spans to external multi-tenant SaaS cloud
Prohibitive linear per-span pricing ($185,000/yr at 5M spans/mo; $1,085,000/yr at 50M GECX spans/mo)

braintrust.deployment_model: Hybrid Cloud (External SaaS Control Plane + Internal Data Plane Proxy)
strengths: Strong developer CI/CD evaluation dataset ergonomics and prompt playground
Hybrid data plane keeps raw blob payloads inside AWS/GCP VPC
disqualifiers_for_syf: CONDITIONAL / HIGH RISK: Evaluation scores, dataset metadata, and user identifiers still egress to Braintrust SaaS control plane
High volume scaling cost ($135,000/yr at 5M spans/mo; $804,000/yr at 50M GECX spans/mo)

langfuse.vendor_name: Langfuse Enterprise (Self-Hosted on ROSA / Cloud Run)
langfuse.deployment_model: 100% Self-Hosted Container inside Synchrony Private VPC (AWS ROSA OpenShift or Google Cloud Run Private Subnets)
strengths: 100% Zero-Egress PCI-DSS v4.0 & CareCredit HIPAA compliant (all spans stay inside Synchrony private VPC ClickHouse + PostgreSQL)
Zero per-span ingestion fees ($76,000/yr total TCO at 5M spans/mo saving $109,000/yr vs. Arize; $130,000/yr at 50M spans/mo saving $955,000/yr vs. Arize)
Native OpenTelemetry W3C TraceContext (traceparent) collector support with 13.8ms P95 ingestion latency (<25ms SLA)
disqualifiers_for_syf: Requires SYF-Platform-Mesh-Squad to manage ClickHouse + Langfuse containers on ROSA OpenShift or Cloud Run Private Subnets
